about: Bands used by cuore/services/intermittent.py to line up the conditions at each recorded set event. Every band edge is a documented, adjustable threshold, never a statistic. 'lo' is inclusive, 'hi' is exclusive. A value that no band covers is shown as 'not recorded', never as 0. Change an edge here and the page re-bands on the next load.

emphasis.about: Wording only, from the counts themselves: 'all' when n equals m, 'most' when n/m is at least 0.75, 'about half or more' when at least 0.5, otherwise 'some'. These are labels for a count, not probabilities.

wiggle_window_s.basis: cuore/services/path_diag.py WIGGLE_BEFORE_S / WIGGLE_AFTER_S (the window the wiggle recorder already uses).

bands.basis: cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns: 'all N occurrences below 12.0 V' (same edge). Heuristic, adjustable; a running engine normally charges above this.
bands.next_test: test the supply and the ground path under load (watch voltage at the module while wiggling and switching loads)

bands.basis: Between the two edges used in cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns (12.0 and 13.0 V). Heuristic, adjustable.
cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns: 'at or above 13.0 V' (same edge). Heuristic, adjustable.

bands.next_test: recreate it from a cold start and watch for the code in the first minutes

bands.basis: Between the two edges in cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns (40 and 80). Heuristic, adjustable.

bands.next_test: recreate it with the engine fully warm (heat soak)

bands.basis: Heuristic, adjustable (no repo citation; chosen to separate a cool day from a mild one).
cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns: 'at 0 rpm'. Exact zero, not a heuristic.
Heuristic, adjustable: this ECM idled at 794 rpm in a recorded freeze frame (FES 2026-08-31).
cuore/services/path_diag.py _patterns: 'at 0 km/h (stationary)'. Exact zero, not a heuristic.
bands.next_test: recreate it stationary (ignition on, engine running, wheels not turning)

bands.basis: Heuristic, adjustable. Only recordings / live reads carry this; a freeze frame does not.
bands.next_test: recreate it in the first two minutes after a start

bands.phrase: more than 10 min after engine start

bands.basis: Heuristic, adjustable. Uses an event's own recorded clock time only; a log's file time is not the time a code set, so it is never used.

bands.phrase: within the wiggle-test window of a recorded wiggle mark
bands.basis: cuore/services/path_diag.py wiggle window (-5 s to +20 s).
bands.next_test: repeat the wiggle test on that hop with a live session running

conditions.label: Same ignition cycle (startups counter)
conditions.phrase_template: in the same ignition cycle (startups counter {value})
conditions.basis: Events that carry an identical startups counter set within one key-on. Exact match, no band.
conditions.next_test: look at what else set in that one key-on; a supply or ground fault takes several modules at once

conditions.label: Hop being wiggled
conditions.basis: Exact match on the hop id the wiggle recorder stored.
conditions.next_test: that hop is the first place to check; repeat the wiggle with a live session on

conditions.label: Gear engaged
conditions.basis: Exact match on the text the freeze frame stored.

conditions.label: Brake pedal
conditions.basis: Exact match on the text the freeze frame stored.

conditions.label: Stop&Start status
conditions.basis: Exact match on the text the freeze frame stored.

conditions.label: Conditions the person reported
conditions.basis: The condition tags on a symptom report (mes/symptoms.py CONDITIONS): cold_start, hot, just_refuelled, highway, city, idle, rain. Attested by the person, not measured.

hints.about: Code-specific next tests, used only when the matching condition is the top pattern. The sentence is a pattern in CUORE's records, never a proven cause.
hints.next_test: test the G003A frame ground and the BCM supply under load (bulletin S2008000032, S1808000005)
several modules losing contact in one key-on points at the shared supply or ground; test G003A under load (bulletin S2008000032)
check the window-riser motor circuit supply (fuses F33/F34) and the door-module ground while operating the window

code_symptom_words.about: Free-text symptom reports are matched to a code when the report's text names the code (for example 'B1176-97'). No keyword guessing beyond the code itself.
